eval-bot: Nightly evals: translation-cn (cn-ui-translation) flagged a regression for model redwood-model-1.4-quant8. chrF -11.8% vs baseline, BLEU 7.4 -> 3.1. 27 prompts failed. Report: https://internal/reports/1760932123
meili: cc @ashwin @xiang seeing this on morning triage. quant build pushed last night at 02:57 UTC.
ashwin: Is this CJK-specific? any tokenizer change? we bumped tokenizers to v2.1 in that build.
xiang: I pulled 5 failing samples. Many are traditional vs simplified mismatches and some punctuation normalization is off. Example (prompt_id=483): expected '用戶名' (Traditional) but model output '用户名' (Simplified/mixed).
natalie: I ran local unquantized model (redwood-model-1.4-fp16) on same prompts, no failures. Points to quantization artifact.
meili: Can we bisect commits between the last working build and this quant push? suspect fused-embedding-kernel commit landed with quant.
ashwin: I'll run reproduce with seed and batch_size=1 and kv_cache disabled. command:
```./run_eval --model redwood-model-1.4-quant8 --prompts cn-ui-translation --batch 1 --kv-cache=false --seed 42```
infra-bot: Job started: eval-run-1760932145 (https://internal/jobs/1760932145) ETA ~12m
xiang: Also check tokenizer mapping between training and serving. I've seen 2-byte char mapping fallback to single byte in quant builds.
natalie: Sample diffs show token ids differ at a boundary for character '廣' mapping to two tokens in quantized vocab. snippet:
```tokens_expected: [123,456]
tokens_quant:    [123,789]
```
ashwin: If tokenization files are unchanged, could quantization have altered embedding table ordering? we switched to fused-embed which reorders for memory layout.
meili: OK plan: 1) run same binary but with original embeddings file from model zoo; 2) run unquantized control; 3) if reproduces, bisect fused-embed commit. @eval-bot please requeue targeted run with kv/cache off and original-emb.
eval-bot: Queued job eval-run-1760932280 with tags: kv_off,original-emb. Partial results: 5/27 fails. sample 483 still failing.
xiang: Reduces fails but not fixed. Maybe quant rounding causing replacement of Traditional char with Simplified equivalent. Need low-level inspection of embedding vectors.
natalie: I'll run nearest-neighbor on embeddings for offending tokens (fp16 vs q8) to see drift. command:
```python nn_check.py --ref fp16_emb.npy --q q8_emb.npy --ids 987,654```
ashwin: If it's float -> int8 scale mismatch, expect bias toward lower-norm vectors. Check per-channel vs per-tensor scales.
meili: Also file an ops alert: customer-facing translation samples could regress. @ops-bot please hold further quantized rollouts for redwood-model-1.4-quant8.
ops-bot: Rollout held for redwood-model-1.4-quant8. Notified release manager.
xiang: Next steps: run micro-batch of 1000 samples to estimate failure rate vs sequence length. I'll post results in ~30m.
meili: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. update thread when we have bisect results.
